channel.title: Creedy Solutions: DrumClock guides
channel.description: Setup guides and free tools for playing without a click track: MIDI clock and tap tempo that follow a live drummer.

item.title: Make Ableton Live follow a live drummer: Tempo Follower vs MIDI clock from the drums | Creedy Solutions
item.description: Two ways to make Ableton Live follow a human drummer instead of a click: Live's built-in Tempo Follower, and MIDI clock from a beat tracker by the kit. Setup for each, what breaks, and how to keep pedals and keys on the same beat.

item.title: Free online metronome with tap tempo | Creedy Solutions
item.description: Free online metronome: set or tap a tempo, pick the time signature and accent, and it keeps steady time in your browser. 30 to 300 BPM.

item.title: Tap tempo and delay time calculator (BPM to ms, dotted eighth) | Creedy Solutions
item.description: Free tap tempo and delay time calculator: tap or type a BPM and get quarter, eighth, dotted-eighth, triplet and sixteenth delay times in milliseconds, plus a chart from 60 to 180 BPM.

item.title: Playing without a click track: how bands stay tight with no click | Creedy Solutions
item.description: Plenty of great bands play without a click. How to stay tight without one, when a click is worth it, and how to keep delays, arps and tracks-free keys in time with a human drummer.

item.title: MIDI clock from live drums: make the drummer the master clock | Creedy Solutions
item.description: How to generate MIDI clock and tap tempo from a live drummer instead of a click track: what a beat tracker does, what it needs to hear, how tight it gets, and how to wire it to keys, pedals and a DAW.

item.title: Sunday Keys tap tempo from the drummer (no MIDI clock needed) | Creedy Solutions
item.description: Sunday Keys doesn't take MIDI clock, but its tap tempo can be MIDI-learned. Here's how to have every beat of your live drummer tap it for you, so delays and arps stay in time all service with no click or in-ears.

item.title: How to sync delays and arps to a live drummer (no click, no in-ears) | Creedy Solutions
item.description: Keep delay repeats, arpeggiators and sequencers in time with a human drummer when the band has no click track or in-ear monitors. Three ways to do it, plus setup notes for Sunday Keys, Helix, Strymon, Ableton and MainStage.
